info.title: mcmesh gateway API
info.description: Operator and tool facing routes. The host protocol (leases, WAL, blob upload) is described in board/PROTOCOL.md. Request and response bodies are documented there, per route; this file lists every route with its method, authorisation and path parameters so tools and tests can tell what exists.

bearer.description: A device token from the login flow, or an API key (mcmesh_sk_...) where the route allows scoped keys.

error.description: A stable code such as NOT_MEMBER, OWNER_ONLY, BAD_REASON.

to.description: Player name of the new owner, who must be a member.

role.description: Omit or null to remove the member.

quorum.description: distinct devices that must report the same digest, default 2

halo.description: chunks generated around a tile and thrown away, default 4; a tile keeps the value it was requested with

profile.description: hash of everything that decides generation (mods, configs, seed); a worker only gets tiles for its own profile

tiles.description: south-west chunk [x, z] of each 32 x 32 tile, on the region grid

hash.description: sha256 of the chunk blob in the CAS, hex

frontier.description: a chunk just outside the tile that carries the spill of its edge, not covered by the digest

digest.description: sha256 over the canonical per-chunk digests of the tile, hex

chunk_digests.description: optional, the per-chunk digests concatenated as hex, kept for diagnosing a disagreement

leaves.description: generator only: every chunk of the tile, blobs already uploaded

get.description: Authorisation: any member. No reasons are returned; hosts use this to keep their own ban list in step.
Authorisation: owner or admin. Open ones; ?all=1 adds decided ones.

post.summary: Appeal a ban
post.description: Authorisation: a banned player of this world. One open appeal at a time.

post.summary: Decide an appeal
post.description: Authorisation: owner or admin. decision is lift (removes the ban) or keep.

get.description: Authorisation: owner or admin. Bans, unbans, reports, appeals and decisions, newest first, from the audit log.

Authorisation: member. Same events as the long poll; each event carries id = its sequence number, reconnect with Last-Event-ID or ?after=. A reset event means the gateway restarted. Ends after an hour.

post.summary: Anchor reports its memory and cores
post.description: Authorisation: a device an operator flagged with set-anchor (403 NOT_AN_ANCHOR otherwise). Registering never makes a device an anchor.

get.description: Authorisation: gateway admin. Flagged devices with memory, profile and the world each is hosting.

get.summary: Distributed worldgen settings and tile counts

put.summary: Turn distributed worldgen on or off for a world
put.description: Authorisation: owner or admin. Off by default because it spends other members' CPU.

get.summary: Tiles ready to install, and tiles the peers never agreed on
get.description: Authorisation: the world's current host (403 NOT_LEASE_HOLDER). Returns at most four ready tiles per call, each with the generator's chunk list.

post.summary: Ask for tiles to be generated
post.description: Authorisation: the world's current host. Idempotent per tile and profile; 409 WORLDGEN_OFF, TILE_NOT_ALIGNED, TILE_QUEUE_FULL.

post.summary: The host has installed a tile or taken note of a refused one

get.summary: A worker asks which seeds it could generate tiles for
get.description: Authorisation: a member allowed to host. Returns {demand: [{seed, profile}]} for queued tiles of worlds the device may help with, never its own hosted world. A worker derives its profile from its own seed, so it needs the seed before it starts a server.

post.summary: A worker asks for a tile to work on
post.description: Authorisation: a member allowed to host, who is not the world's current host. Returns {claim: null} when nothing fits the profile. A device holds one claim at a time, asking again resumes it. role is generate (upload the chunks, then report a digest and the chunk list) or verify (report a digest only).

put.summary: A worker reports what it generated
put.description: Authorisation: the device holding the claim. outcome is waiting, ready, retry (the peers disagreed, another round follows) or rejected (they never agree, the pack does not reproduce tiles). 409 NO_CLAIM, CLAIM_EXPIRED, TILE_INCOMPLETE, LEAF_OUT_OF_TILE, LEAVES_REQUIRED, LEAVES_NOT_ALLOWED; 400 MISSING_BLOB when a listed chunk was never uploaded.

get.summary: Live shard leases and open offers of a world
get.description: Authorisation: a member of the world. Returns {shards: [{id, device, regions}], offers: [{id, regions}]}.

post.summary: The main host sets regions aside for another machine
post.description: Authorisation: the world's current host. regions is a list of {dim, x1, z1, x2, z2}, inclusive region (32 x 32 chunk) coordinates. 409 SHARD_OVERLAP when a region is already reserved, BAD_SHARD_REGIONS, NOT_LEASE_HOLDER. From then on the main host's WAL may not write chunks in these regions.

post.summary: A machine that may host takes the oldest open offer
post.description: Authorisation: a member allowed to host. Returns {grant: null} or {grant: {id, epoch, base_rev, regions, hmac_key, ttl_s, heartbeat_s}}. The shard lease writes only chunks inside its regions and the player files playerdata/, advancements/ and stats/.

post.summary: A shard host stays alive
post.description: Authorisation: the shard lease's device. A shard that misses heartbeats for the lease TTL ends, and what reached its last barrier becomes a RECOVERED revision.

post.summary: A shard host appends WAL frames
post.description: Same frames and HMAC chain as /v1/leases/{id}/wal. 409 Rejected OUT_OF_SHARD for a chunk outside the shard's regions or an aux file that is not a player file.

post.summary: A shard host seals its WAL into a revision
post.description: The revision is built from the shard's frames up to its last barrier on top of whatever the head is, so shard commits and the main host's commits do not wait for each other. last ends the shard and returns its regions to the main host. kind is AUTOSAVE or SHUTDOWN.

post.summary: A shard host says its server is up
post.description: Authorisation: the shard lease's device. Answers {ok}; nothing waits for it.

post.summary: The main host has taken a shard's regions and players back
post.description: Authorisation: the world's current host. Until then the shard's regions are reserved and its players are turned away at the relay. 409 NO_SUCH_SHARD, NOT_LEASE_HOLDER.
